symptom: ako/mxcli#1703 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1659): `describe layout Atlas_Core.Atlas_SideBar` printed `scrollcontainer layoutContainer {` with no LayoutMode and `create layout` could not write one, so the documented describe → rename → exec copy of Atlas_SideBar (stored LayoutMode Sidebar) was a Headline layout — a different frame; `(LayoutMode: 'Sidebar')` passed check and exec and was dropped; mx check 0 errors either way.
cause: Forms$ScrollContainer.LayoutMode (Headline | Sidebar) had no field on pages.ScrollContainer, no read in buildScrollContainerV3, no SetLayoutMode in the modelsdk writer, no parse in describe, and no ALTER SET case; the copies came out Headline only because canon.CompletePropertySets fills the absent key with Studio Pro's measured default. The key passed check because the MDL-WIDGET07 vocabulary was a union, and layouts were walked by no widget rule.
file: sdk/pages/pages_widgets_container.go (ScrollContainer.LayoutMode, CanonicalScrollContainerLayoutMode); mdl/executor/cmd_pages_builder_v3.go (buildScrollContainerV3); mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_write.go; mdl/executor/cmd_pages_describe_parse.go + cmd_pages_describe_output.go; mdl/backend/pagemutator/mutator.go (setScrollContainerLayoutModeMut)
insight: Measured the stored documents before choosing the describe policy: of the 17 Atlas_Core layouts with a scroll container on 11.13, 8 are Sidebar and 9 Headline, and canon's measured defaults say Studio Pro fills an absent key with Headline — so describe prints only Sidebar and the writer writes the key only when stated, which leaves every layout that never set it byte-identical. Both 'every widget and every key matches' copy tests (TestCopyEveryAtlasLayoutKeepsEveryWidget compared $Types and key SETS) were green while the value was wrong: a key-set comparison cannot see a defaulted value — add the value. With the per-widget verdict of ako/mxcli#1698 in place the same script was refused (MDL-WIDGET52) instead of dropped before the support existed, which is the class fix doing its job on the next instance. ALTER SET writes only a stored key, never invents one (overlay rule). Verified on a fresh 11.13 app: copy stores Sidebar, describe of the copy matches, alter set flips Headline → Sidebar, mx check 0 errors.
